hero.title: Manage your teams. Plan your training. Grow together.
hero.subtitle: Training Manager brings your team, schedule, attendance and stats into one tool built for coaches.

features_page.title: Everything you need to run your teams
features_page.subtitle: From session planning to attendance logging, with AI-assisted training generation. Built for coaches, by coaches.

teams.title: Team management
teams.description: Create your teams, invite athletes by email, assign manager roles, manage rosters across the season.

planning.title: Programs & calendar
planning.description: Build your training cycles, plan sessions on the calendar, adjust on the fly.

ai.title: AI generation
ai.description: Ask the AI to generate a session schedule from a program, or a complete training from a single session.

attendance.title: Attendance tracking
attendance.description: Bulk-log attendance after each session. View your own attendance history as an athlete.

i18n.title: 5 languages
i18n.description: Interface available in French, Dutch, English, Italian and Spanish. Choice saved on your profile.

roles.title: Coach and athlete roles
roles.description: One app, two views: coach dashboard to manage, athlete view to follow your sessions and your attendance.
